case_title.reason: Matches the judgment's header: Govindaraju @ Govinda v. State by Sriramapuram P.S.

number_of_accused.reason: The Court decides the liability of one appellant, Govindaraju, though two were tried.

accused_gender.reason: The judgment refers to the accused with male pronouns and as 'his' throughout.

accused_age.reason: No age of the accused is stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is stated.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.reason: The accused's occupation is not mentioned.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on the accused's wealth or class appears.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: The victim is referred to with male pronouns and as 'husband' of the wife.

victim_age.reason: The victim's age is not stated.

victim_caste.reason: No caste or community of the victim is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religion of the victim is stated.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Brother's statement describes a prior police complaint of a fight between accused and deceased; Court relied on it.

offence_category.reason: The charge is murder under s.302 IPC read with s.34.

statutory_provisions.reason: Charge was under Section 302 read with Section 34 IPC.

weapon.reason: The weapon was a knife, referred to as 'chaku' in the FSL report.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, recovery, medical and FSL evidence are all discussed as the kinds of evidence presented.

confession.reason: No confession by the accused is relied on; recoveries tied to disclosure statements were found defective.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Ten stab injuries to the chest recorded in the post-mortem report
aggravating_circumstances.quote: there were as many as 10 injuries on the person of the deceased
aggravating_circumstances.reason: The injuries are correctly noted, but the judgment has no sentencing discussion, so the claim the Court did not weigh them is unsupported.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating facts are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court acquitted both accused of s.302 read with s.34 IPC.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court granted leave against the accused, convicted under s.302, and sentenced him to life and Rs.10,000 fine.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court allowed the appeal and acquitted the appellant of s.302 IPC.

offence_finally_established.reason: Accused was acquitted, so no offence is finally established.

imprisonment_type.reason: Accused acquitted and set at liberty, so no final sentence type applies.

imprisonment_years.reason: No final fixed-term sentence exists after acquittal.

fine_rs.reason: No final fine exists after acquittal.

neutral_facts.reason: Summary covers incident, investigation and evidence without names, court outcomes or accused gender or status.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the punishment prescribed for s.302 IPC.

attempt_completion.reason: The victim was stabbed and declared dead, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: Death from shock and haemorrhage due to stab injuries to the chest is stated.

number_of_offences.reason: One charge (s.302 r/w s.34) with no conviction upheld matches the judgment.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is relevant to this offence.

premeditation_planning.reason: The judgment does not discuss premeditation or planning.

motive.reason: No motive is identified; a prior fight is mentioned but not established as motive.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Post-mortem establishing knife injuries was accepted; the eyewitness and recovery evidence were rejected, as stated.

witness_credibility.reason: PW-1's distance, FIR omission, lack of corroboration, hostile witnesses and PW-11's omissions all match the judgment.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Flight into the conservancy is labelled as the prosecution version and not established, matching the judgment.

custody_duration.reason: The judgment does not state how long the accused was in custody.

bail_history.reason: Court ordered bail and surety bonds discharged; earlier bail history is not stated.

trial_duration.reason: All four dates (offence, trial judgment, High Court, Supreme Court) match the judgment.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for appellant and respondents match the judgment's listing.

investigation_status.reason: FIR, investigation, charge-sheet and completed trial are all described in the judgment.

procedural_irregularity.reason: Non-examined witnesses, unsigned recovery memos and unproven blood group are all noted by the Court.

appeal_history.reason: Trial acquittal, High Court conviction and Supreme Court acquittal are correctly stated.

prosecution_argument.reason: State's contentions on false implication, PW-1, house recovery and panchas match the judgment.

defence_argument.reason: Points (i)-(vii) on hostile witnesses, recovery, medical evidence and co-accused parity are accurately reflected.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Appeal-against-acquittal test, police witness reliability, hostile witnesses and adverse inference are all applied by the Court.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Principal precedents relied on or referred to are listed with citations matching the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Accused was acquitted, so no sentencing rationale applies.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The Court weighed no mitigating factors for sentencing.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The Court weighed no aggravating factors for sentencing.

other_sentence_order.reason: Accused set at liberty forthwith and bail and surety bonds discharged, as ordered.
